description: Two overlapping areas whose fills fade out toward the bottom using SVG linear gradients.
overview: Two overlapping series whose fills fade to transparent toward the baseline, so the lower series stays visible through the upper one. Reach for it over the flat-filled default when you compare two series that cross each other.
usage: Replace `chartData` and rename the two series keys consistently across the data, the areas and `chartConfig`. Each series needs its own gradient in the `defs` block, so add or rename one when you add a series. Raise or lower the top stop's `stopOpacity` to make the fill stronger or subtler.
notes: The series are drawn in source order, so the last `Area` sits on top. Focus the plot and use the arrow keys to move the tooltip between months.
